svg.title: Indeed remove one factor on the left. Only factors of the same index on the right can pair with it, giving βidi; induction proves the formula, starting with the empty monomial. These are Wick products at each insertion, so within-insertion contractions are absent. Therefore for a polynomial P = P α pαeα, ⟨P, P⟩refl= X α |pα|2 Y i αi!dαi i > 0 (P ̸= 0).
